description: 阅读理解：基于课文的选择题，检验理解程度

questions.question: What is the story about?
questions.questionCn: 这个故事是关于什么的？
questions.explanation: 故事的主角是一个硬纸板箱（cardboard box），讲述了它从被使用到被回收再利用的奇妙旅程。

questions.question: What was the cardboard box worried about at first?
questions.questionCn: 硬纸板箱一开始担心什么？
questions.explanation: 纸箱一开始担心：Will they throw me away? 他们会把我扔掉吗？

questions.question: Who picked up the cardboard box in the afternoon?
questions.questionCn: 下午谁捡起了硬纸板箱？
questions.explanation: 课文说：In the afternoon, a man picked me up and put me into a recycling bin. 下午，一个男人把我捡起来，放进了回收箱。

questions.question: Where did the man put the cardboard box?
questions.questionCn: 男人把硬纸板箱放在了哪里？
questions.explanation: 男人把纸箱放进了回收箱（recycling bin），而不是普通垃圾桶。

questions.question: What was NOT on the truck?
questions.explanation: 课文说卡车上有 plastic cups, plastic bottles 和 glass bottles，但没有提到书。书是纸箱最后变成的东西。

questions.question: Where did the truck take them?
questions.questionCn: 卡车把他们带到了哪里？
questions.explanation: The truck took us to a recycling centre. 卡车把我们带到了一个回收中心。

questions.question: What did workers do at the recycling centre?
questions.questionCn: 工人在回收中心做了什么？

options.label: A
options.textCn: 他们把所有东西都扔掉了。

options.label: B
options.text: They put things into different groups.
options.textCn: 他们把东西分成不同的组。

questions.explanation: Workers put us into different groups. 工人们把我们分成不同的组。这就是垃圾分类回收的过程。

questions.question: What did the cardboard box become in the end?
questions.questionCn: 硬纸板箱最后变成了什么？
questions.explanation: Yes, I'm a book now! 是的，我现在是一本书了！纸箱经过回收再利用，最后变成了图书馆里的一本书。

questions.question: How did the cardboard box feel at the end?
questions.questionCn: 硬纸板箱最后感觉怎么样？
questions.explanation: Children like me very much. How wonderful! 孩子们非常喜欢我。多么奇妙啊！纸箱最后很开心，因为它获得了新生。

questions.question: What are the students doing?

options.label: B
options.text: They are doing an art project with old things.
options.textCn: 他们在用旧物品做一个美术项目。

questions.explanation: The students are doing an art project with old things. 学生们正在用旧物品做一个美术项目。

questions.question: What did Billy make with old trousers?
questions.explanation: Billy说：I made this bag with old trousers. 我用旧裤子做了这个袋子。

questions.question: What did Sam make with a plastic bag and some paper?
questions.questionCn: Sam用一个塑料袋和一些纸做了什么？
questions.explanation: Sam说：Look at this toy fish. I made it with a plastic bag and some paper. 看这条玩具鱼，我用一个塑料袋和一些纸做的。

questions.question: What did Willy make with old buttons?
questions.explanation: Willy说：I made this picture with old buttons. 我用旧纽扣做了这幅画。

questions.question: What happened to Bobby's hat?
questions.explanation: Bobby说：But it was rainy this morning. The hat got wet and broke. 但是今天早上下雨了，帽子湿了，然后坏了。

questions.question: What is the main idea of this unit?
questions.questionCn: 这个单元的主旨是什么？

options.label: A
options.text: We should throw away old things.

options.label: C
options.text: Old things can have a new life through recycling and creative reuse.
options.textCn: 旧东西可以通过回收和创意再利用获得新生。

options.label: D
options.text: We should buy more new things.
options.textCn: 我们应该买更多新东西。

questions.explanation: 单元主题是「Old things, new life（旧物新生）」。通过纸箱的回收旅程和同学们的旧物艺术展，告诉我们旧东西不是没用的垃圾，通过回收再利用和创意改造，它们可以获得新的生命。
